I'll loop in Priyom and Laura to confirm approval and next steps. Attaching Redwood's simplified PO form in case you prefer to issue one (not required for this size, but acceptable).

Attachments: [PO_Request_SprintPilot_v1.pdf (application/pdf)]

- SprintPilot sends W9 + billing email and preferred invoice cadence
- Sign the standard pilot SOW (I can push a DocuSign)
- Redwood finance creates a temporary invoice-only vendor record and issues first invoice after SOW signature

If finance pushes back we will escalate for a one-off PO exemption approval; I expect approval for pilot-sized engagement but want to get forms in place.

— Aditya

Thanks for the context. Finance position: we can approve an invoice-only onboarding for pilots under USD 10k if the following controls are met — this is our temporary exception framework and should be documented in the vendor record. Please confirm SprintPilot can provide these items before we mark the vendor as "invoice-only":

Required evidence (to be uploaded into Coupa/vendor portal):
- Completed W9 (or W-8 if non-US) — we need PDF
- Primary billing contact email and AP contact name/phone
- Signed pilot SOW or DocuSign envelope reference
- Invoice will be routed to invoices@redwood.ai with PO# field left blank and a reference to deal ID SP-2026-042

Approval matrix (finance):
- Pilot <= 10k: AP/local finance sign-off (LAURA) — temporary invoice-only flag valid for 30 days from first invoice
- Pilot 10k-25k: Procurement (PRIYOM) + finance sign-off; require explicit PO or exec approval to waive
- >25k: Standard PO required in advance.

If Priyom approves the exception I will add the vendor record and share the vendor ID and invoice routing instructions.

Attachment: [Supplier_W9_SprintPilot.pdf (application/pdf)]

Laura Bennett
Finance Manager, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.ai

Looping back — procurement reviewed. Given the pilot size (~6.4k) and that we have a signed SOW and completed W9, we will approve a time-limited invoice-only onboarding for SprintPilot under the following binding conditions: 

1) Exception window: 60 days from first invoice. Invoice-only vendor flag will expire automatically; any renewal or extension requires either an issued PO or renewed exception.
2) SprintPilot must send invoices to invoices@redwood.ai with the deal ID SP-2026-042 in the subject and line items matching the signed SOW.
3) Redwood will not accept liability beyond the SOW for invoice-only engagements; any scope change requiring additional spend must be governed by a PO or approved addendum.
4) Procurement will create a temporary vendor profile in our system with ID VP-2026-889 and attach the W9 and PO-form stub for audit.

Actions for Emily: please reply-all with the PDF W9 (if not attached), confirm AP contact and billing email, and accept the temporary exception terms. Priyom will add the vendor and set the flag once documents are uploaded.

I attached the internal approval note we record for exceptions (redacted).

Attachments: [Procurement_Exception_Record_SP-2026-042.txt (text/plain)]

Thanks — Priyom
